name: alyt
description: All-in-one Analytics SDK — define events in YAML, get a fully typed TypeScript tracker, and fan out to multiple providers through a single API
author: Mathematic Inc

scripts.prepare: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const options = { shell: process.platform === 'win32', stdio: 'ignore' }; if (spawnSync('hk', ['--version'], options).status === 0) process.exit(spawnSync('hk', ['install'], { ...options, stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 1)"
